## AMD's Next AI Accelerator Ships with 432GB Memory — 50% More Than Prior Generation

A 50% memory-capacity jump meaningfully expands AMD's addressable use cases for large-model workloads; the pricing signal (implied but unquantified) will determine how aggressively hyperscalers qualify and deploy the new accelerator relative to Nvidia alternatives.

- AMD's next-generation AI accelerator carries 432GB of memory, a 50% increase over the prior generation.
- The Globe and Mail headline references accompanying pricing ('here's the bill'), implying cost is a notable factor.
- The memory uplift positions AMD more competitively for large-model inference and training workloads.
- Specific pricing is referenced but not quantified in the headline.
